gaps.lead: He's not old enough to ride a motorbike.
I'd prefer you to arrive before eight.
gaps.explanation: would rather + subject + past simple: I'd rather you arrived.

gaps.lead: Their wedding will take place in June.
gaps.explanation: Weddings/concerts are held: will be held (in June).

gaps.lead: They arrived late because the traffic was terrible.
gaps.sentence: The traffic was ___ they arrived late.

gaps.lead: When I was a boy, we walked everywhere.
gaps.sentence: When I was a boy, we ___ everywhere.
gaps.explanation: used to + infinitive expresses a past habit.

gaps.lead: This is the worst traffic I've ever experienced.
gaps.explanation: Never before + have + subject + participle: Never have I experienced.
